description:
Create a collection from one or more artifacts - make work known to the space (kythe it). Artifacts carry name, mime and content; tags are created as needed. The response collection carries `url`, its canonical link - hand THAT to a person (or another agent) to point them at the work, not the bare id. This path is for text and small artifacts (libapi appends this endpoint's real byte ceiling below); for a larger or binary file use `kythe create-collection <file>`, which reads the bytes off disk - up to 32 MiB per artifact - instead of routing them through the model.

Over MCP the whole request is limited to 1048576 bytes, and base64 inflates content by 4/3, so roughly 786432 bytes of file is the practical maximum here. Larger content goes over the API or the CLI, which have no such ceiling.

artifacts.description: artifacts is the new content to publish.

content.description:
content carries the artifact bytes (32 MiB max per artifact over the API
 and the CLI). An MCP request is capped far lower - the tool description
 carries that endpoint's real ceiling.

mime.description: mime is the content type; defaults to application/octet-stream.

name.description: name is the artifact's filename-like name, e.g. "bench-results.json".

note.description: note is an optional version note.

existingArtifactIds.description:
existing_artifact_ids references already-published artifacts into this
 collection (curation/re-bundling).

idempotencyKey.description:
idempotency_key makes a publish safe to retry: if a publish times out on the
 client (a large body embeds synchronously and can outlast the client timeout,
 even though the write has already committed) but the same key is sent again,
 the server returns the collection already created for that key instead of
 creating a duplicate. Optional; a client should generate one per publish
 attempt and reuse it across retries of that attempt.

producer.description:
producer names the publishing instance (e.g. "claude-on-heavy") for
 provenance; defaults to the authenticated user's name.

reviewRequested.description:
review_requested opts this collection into the approval flow, so the space
 sees approve/reject controls; otherwise it is shared content with comments.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

tags.description: tags to attach (created in the space if they do not exist yet).

title.description: title names the collection; defaults to the first artifact's name.

name: create_collection

title.description: title is what the collection is called.

url.description:
url is the canonical link to this collection (.../c/<id>) - the thing to hand
 to a person or paste into a message. It redirects through sign-in to the
 right space, so it works for anyone with access, from any device.

title: Publish work
